verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents no-code audiences that sync to ad platforms (with identifier match boosting) and engagement tools like Braze. Syncs run on a schedule, on a trigger, or when data changes, and CDC sends only added, changed and removed rows, which covers members entering and exiting. Marketing pages claim real-time sync to 300+ destinations. missing for 10: documented latency or streaming-audience specifics backing "near-real-time" membership changes, independent or hands-on corroboration of continuous audience sync to ad platforms.
